## Routing note

Ideas graduate through `wip/` (see `wip/README.md`): collaborative WIP, an
exact Gate 1 promotion directive, formal spec-first planning, then a separate
exact Gate 2 directive before implementation. Filing an issue grants no
approval and starts no clock.

Automation may validate or review a future candidate, but its output is
advisory evidence only. Agentic remediation, Autofix, automatic
commit/push/PR/merge, release, and deployment remain disabled and deferred.
